requirement:
Build a beginner-friendly course about HTML from this PDF.

  Requirements:
  - Target audience: complete beginners with no web
  development background
  - Language: clear English
  - Tone: simple, practical, encouraging, and teacher-
  friendly
  - Course objective: help learners understand the basics of
  HTML and create a simple web page on their own
  - Structure: create short progressive lessons from
  introduction to practice
  - Include quizzes after each major concept
  - Include teacher narration/scripts for each lesson
  - Include at least one interactive or practical scene
  where the learner identifies HTML tags or reads a small
  HTML example
  - Emphasize:
    - HTML document structure
    - headings and paragraphs
    - links and images
    - lists
    - tables
    - forms
    - semantic HTML
    - good practices
  - End with a final review quiz
  - Keep the content practical and easy to follow
